title: KLIA2 to KL Sentral: Bus, Train, Taxi and Grab Compared
metaDescription: KLIA2 to KL Sentral by bus from about RM12, KLIA Ekspres for RM55, or taxi and Grab. Times, fares, late arrivals and which suits your group.

contentBlocks.content: There are four ways to get from KLIA2 to KL Sentral. The airport bus costs about RM12 to RM15 and takes about an hour. The KLIA Ekspres train costs RM55 and takes about 33 minutes, with the last train around midnight. A taxi or Grab takes 45 to 60 minutes depending on traffic and drops you at your door. The bus costs least and the train is quickest. Which one is right for you depends on three things: how many of you are travelling, what time you land, and whether your hotel is actually near KL Sentral.
Key Takeaways
What costs least from KLIA2 to KL Sentral? The airport bus, at about RM12 to RM15 per person. It leaves from the Transportation Hub on Level 1 and takes about an hour.
What is the fastest way? The KLIA Ekspres, about 33 minutes from KLIA2 to KL Sentral for RM55 per adult (KLIA Ekspres).
Is the KLIA Transit cheaper? Not to KL Sentral. It costs the same RM55, stops at three more stations and takes 39 minutes.
What if there are four of us? Four adults on the train pay RM220. Four on the bus pay about RM50 to RM60. A fixed price taxi for the whole group is often the easier choice with luggage.
What if I land after 11 PM? Late night trains stop at every station and finish around midnight to 1 AM. Some buses and all taxis run later.

By bus: the lowest fare

Airport buses from KLIA2 to KL Sentral cost about RM12 to RM15 and take about an hour, longer at rush hour. Aerobus, Airport Coach and Skybus all run the route, and some operators have departures after midnight. On 3 October 2026, listings showed buses leaving KLIA2 at 1:00 AM and 1:45 AM.

To find the bus: after customs, come out on Level 2 and follow the signs for "Bus Station". Take the escalator down to the Transportation Hub on Level 1, where every bus platform is. The bus arrives at the KL Sentral bus terminal on the LG floor of the station building, a short walk from the trains.

Book before you land and you skip the ticket counter queue. Your digital ticket is on your phone, so check that your data works first; if you booked a Teeko travel SIM, collect it at the tour centre in KLIA2 before you head down to Level 1; the exact counter details come with your booking.

contentBlocks.content: By train: KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit

The KLIA Ekspres is the fastest way to KL Sentral: about 33 minutes from KLIA2 (3 minutes to KLIA Terminal 1, a short stop, then 28 minutes to KL Sentral), every 20 minutes, from 4:55 AM (KLIA Ekspres). A single ticket is RM55 for adults and RM25 for children aged 6 to 15. Children under 6 ride free, up to three per adult ticket. Buying online or in the KLIA Ekspres app takes 10% off; otherwise buy at the KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit counters or ticket machines on Level 2 of the Gateway@klia2 mall, then go down one level to the platforms.

Late at night the pattern changes. From 11 PM, KLIA Ekspres trains stop at every station on the line, so the trip takes longer, and the last trains leave the airport between midnight and 1 AM. Check the service status banner on the KLIA Ekspres website before you fly; when it shows a combined service, Ekspres and Transit trains share the line and journey times can change.

The KLIA Transit uses the same track but stops at Salak Tinggi, Putrajaya and Cyberjaya, and Bandar Tasik Selatan on the way. It takes 39 minutes from KLIA2 and costs the same RM55 to KL Sentral (KLIA Transit). It only saves money if you are getting off before KL Sentral: Bandar Tasik Selatan, for example, is RM38.40.
What it costs your group
For one person, the bus costs far less than anything else. For a family, the per person fares add up quickly, and a car with one fare starts to make sense.

Check the taxi fare for your group on ttklia.com before you decide. With four people and suitcases, door to door can cost less than four train tickets and saves a second ride from KL Sentral to your hotel.
By taxi or Grab: door to door

A taxi or Grab from KLIA2 to central KL takes 45 to 60 minutes and drops you at your hotel. Grab fares change with demand, so the price at 2 AM or in a storm can be very different from the price at noon; check the app when you land. Grab pickup is at the Transportation Hub on the LG floor of KLIA2; follow the ride hailing signs.

If you would rather know the price before you fly, book a fixed price taxi. ttklia.com sells KLIA2 taxi transfers to KL Sentral, Bukit Bintang and Bangsar by sedan, MPV or van, with no meter and no surge pricing. Your driver tracks your flight and waits in the KLIA2 arrival hall with a name board.
Is KL Sentral the right stop for your hotel?
KL Sentral is the city's main rail interchange, but it is not where most visitors stay. Before you pick a ride, check where your hotel is:

• Bukit Bintang, Pavilion, Jalan Alor. Take the bus from KLIA2 to Lalaport BBCC instead. It ends at an indoor hub linked to the Hang Tuah LRT and Monorail, one stop from Bukit Bintang. Our guide to the Lalaport hub covers lockers, trains and walking routes.
  • Chinatown and Petaling Street. Buses to Pudu Sentral (shown as KL City Centre on booking sites) drop you within walking distance.
  • Brickfields, Bangsar, Mid Valley, or a hotel at KL Sentral itself. KL Sentral is the right stop.
  • KLCC. Go to KL Sentral and change to the LRT, or take a taxi straight there.
From KL Sentral, the LRT, KL Monorail, MRT and KTM Komuter trains reach most of the city. The Monorail station is across the road in the NU Sentral mall, signposted from the main hall.
Arrived hungry? The restaurant directory has places to eat near KL Sentral, Bukit Bintang and the rest of the city.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the least expensive way from KLIA2 to KL Sentral?

The airport bus costs least from KLIA2 to KL Sentral, at about RM12 to RM15 per person for a journey of about an hour. Buses leave from the Transportation Hub on Level 1, and you can book a seat before you land.
Can I take the train from KLIA2 after midnight?
Only just. The last KLIA Ekspres trains leave the airport between midnight and 1 AM, and from 11 PM they stop at every station. If you land later than that, take a late bus or a taxi.
Is the KLIA Transit cheaper than the KLIA Ekspres?

No, not to KL Sentral. Both cost RM55 for an adult from KLIA2 to KL Sentral; the KLIA Transit is slower because it stops at three stations on the way. It is only cheaper if you get off before KL Sentral.
Where is the bus stop at KLIA2?
Airport buses leave from the Transportation Hub on Level 1 of KLIA2. After customs, follow the "Bus Station" signs from Level 2 and take the escalator down.
How long does it take from KLIA2 to KL Sentral?
KLIA2 to KL Sentral takes about 33 minutes on the KLIA Ekspres, 39 minutes on the KLIA Transit, about an hour by bus, and 45 to 60 minutes by taxi or Grab depending on traffic.
Conclusion

For transport from KLIA2 to KL Sentral, take the bus if you are on your own or watching your budget, the KLIA Ekspres if you are in a hurry before midnight, and a fixed price taxi if you are a family with luggage or landing late. Check where your hotel is first; for Bukit Bintang, the Lalaport BBCC bus gets you closer. Book your KLIA2 to KL Sentral bus on ttklia.com before you fly.
